meta.note: Combined M7 canonical numbers. m73 SHAP computed with shap 0.54.1 in venv ~/workspace/.venv-shap-m73 (NOT system python); m73 LIME corrected kernel kw=0.75*sqrt(31). m74 in-processing is simplified reductions-style reweighting (fairlearn NOT installed), labelled honestly. m75 pseudo-time = ID order, NOT a real date.

m2_g4_air.note: angka lesson M2 (scorecard), bukan dari script ini; tidak diverifikasi di sini

m2_g9_psi.note: angka lesson M2 (scorecard), bukan dari script ini; tidak diverifikasi di sini

m71_impossibility_sex.note: Base rate beda (male vs female) -> demographic parity, equalized odds, dan kalibrasi per grup tidak bisa ketiganya sempurna sekaligus; lesson memakai angka-angka ini sebagai bukti numerik impossibility.

m72_locked_verification.m2_g9_psi_note: M2 G9 PSI 0.0104 is an M2-lesson number (its distribution is not defined in the M7.2 brief); PSI train-vs-test computed here for SEX/EDUCATION/MARRIAGE is in psi_train_vs_test for the coordinator to match.

m73_pdp_1d.note: manual PDP: feature set to grid value for all 6000 test rows, mean predicted P(default). Calibrated GBM = decision model.

m73_pdp_2d.note: rows = PAY_MAX, cols = UTILIZATION; mean P(default).

m73_local_case.note: contributions = coef * standardised feature value; they sum (+ intercept) to the LR log-odds exactly.

reason_codes_top3.plain_language: Keterlambatan pembayaran terburuk dalam 6 bulan terakhir

m73_lime_style.note: manual LIME-style surrogate, CORRECTED kernel: perturbations N(0,1) in standardised space, kernel exp(-(d/kw)^2) with kw = 0.75*sqrt(31) = 4.18 (LIME default). First pass used exp(-d^2) (kw=1) -> all weights ~0, R2=0.0003, garbage. lime package itself NOT installed; same idea built by hand.

m73_misleading.note: BILL_AMT1..6 correlate strongly with BILL_MEAN, so permutation importance is SPLIT across the six columns; each looks small, their sum is the honest size of the 'bill' signal.

underfit_gbm_max_iter5.note: A bad model still produces a plausible-looking importance ranking. Explanation quality is bounded by model quality.

m73_no_pay_models.note: Without any PAY_* signal both models lose a lot of ranking power and explain themselves with proxies (LIMIT_BAL, BILL_*, AGE). The explanation looks confident but the model is much worse.

m73_shap_gbm.model: raw GBM (uncalibrated). Decision model is its Platt-calibrated version (monotone transform: same ranking, same top features; exact SHAP values on the calibrated score differ).
m73_shap_gbm.note: TreeExplainer, feature_perturbation='tree_path_dependent' (default). SHAP values in log-odds units; base value = mean log-odds over the training background implied by the trees.

m74_in_processing.method: simplified reductions-style iterative reweighting (NOT full ExponentiatedGradient; fairlearn not installed)

m74_post_processing.method: flagship cell 45 replication: per-group threshold = quantile(proba, overall approval rate)

S1_limit_x1.30.description: LIMIT_BAL x1.30 untuk semua baris test; fitur turunan dihitung ulang

S2_pay_plus1.description: PAY_0..PAY_6 +1 (dibatasi maks 8) untuk semua baris test; fitur turunan dihitung ulang

m7g3_bootstrap_ci.note: CI mencakup 0 (atau 1 untuk AIR) TIDAK berarti 'tidak ada gap' -- hanya dilaporkan angkanya.

missingness.interpretation: Missingness 0 di semua fitur utama (overall, per SEX, per EDUCATION) -- dataset UCI ini lengkap; tidak ada imputasi yang dibutuhkan untuk fitur utama. Bila ada NaN di fitur turunan, itu berasal dari perhitungan (mis. pembagian), bukan dari data mentah.

invalid_categories.interpretation: EDUCATION kode 0/5/6 (di luar 1-4) dan MARRIAGE kode 0 (di luar 1-3) adalah kode 'lainnya/tidak tercatat' di dataset UCI -- kecil persentasenya, tetapi semua masuk grup 'Lainnya' di audit, sehingga grup Lainnya mencampur kode yang berbeda maknanya.

odd_values.interpretation: BILL_AMT negatif = kredit/kelebihan bayar (plausibel di kartu kredit, bukan error); PAY_AMT negatif = pengembalian/penyesuaian (jarang, periksa konsentrasinya); LIMIT_BAL <= 0 dan AGE di luar 21-79 seharusnya 0 -- bila >0, itu artefak data yang wajib dibersihkan sebelum training.

duplicates.interpretation: Duplikat baris penuh (termasuk ID) seharusnya 0 karena ID unik; duplikat di luar ID = baris kembar dari nasabah berbeda -- kecil kemungkinan kebetulan pada 24 kolom, jadi bila >0 patut dicurigai sebagai duplikasi pencatatan.

m7g9_counterfactual_858.note: Counterfactual MODEL: what-if atas masa lalu yang berbeda, bukan rencana aksi — nasabah tidak bisa mengubah riwayat PAY_0..6. PAY_AMT tetap 0 pada CF-A walau PAY=-1 (kombinasi yang ada di data mentah, bukan skenario realistis penuh); CF-B menambahkan pembayaran penuh tiap bulan.
